included: Remove existing furnace and coil in attic, and condenser at exterior
Install new furnace, coil, and condenser in place
Reconnect to existing ductwork, gas, electric, condensate, lineset, flue pipe with new return air plenum
Enlarge return air to meet R454A refrigerant CFM requirements (existing undersized, would cause icing)
Install new electrical disconnect, mounted next to condenser to code
Re-hang system with Unistrut and all-thread to meet local code (previously hung with metal drives, out of code)

structured.notes: Only record with a named contractor and confirmed quote date, but location is still unknown so pricing can't be used as a regional comp yet. Notable good practice: contractor explained WHY the return air needs enlarging (icing risk from undersized return relative to new refrigerant charge) rather than just listing it as a line item - this is a legitimate technical scope add, not an upsell, and is the kind of reasoning Mike should learn to recognize and validate for users. Payment terms: 50% due on acceptance, 50% due on completion.
